requirements.text: Customers must be able to book appointments online at any time
Automated reminders must be sent via SMS or email 24 hours and 1 hour before appointments
Each barber must be able to manage their own schedules, including setting availability and taking breaks
The system must allow customers to cancel or reschedule appointments without calling
The system must provide immediate confirmation of bookings via SMS or email
Tracking of bookings, cancellations, and no-shows must be implemented for analysis
The booking system must be intuitive and easy to use for staff
The solution must be cost-effective for both setup and ongoing fees
The system must integrate easily with existing technology
Customer data must be stored securely and comply with data protection laws
The booking process must be user-friendly and seamless
The booking interface must be usable on mobile devices
